note: Dates checked against organizer sites or major trade press on the 'updated' date. Always confirm on the official site before booking.

events.name: J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference
events.audience: Invitation-only investor conference. Pharma and biotech CEOs, CFOs and BD heads, investors and bankers. Most business happens in side meetings across the city.

events.name: SCOPE Summit
events.audience: Clinical operations, feasibility, data management and outsourcing leaders from sponsors, CROs and sites.

events.name: Gartner Data & Analytics Summit
events.audience: Chief data and analytics officers and data leaders across industries, including pharma; technology buyers evaluating platforms and partners.
events.dateSource: gartner.com venue page and event listings

events.name: AACR Annual Meeting
events.audience: Cancer researchers, translational and discovery teams from pharma and biotech, academic KOLs.

events.name: HIMSS Global Health Conference
events.audience: Health system CIOs and IT teams, EHR and health tech vendors, payers, government health IT. Pharma is a minority of attendees.

events.name: ASGCT Annual Meeting
events.audience: Gene and cell therapy scientists, CMC and manufacturing leaders, biotech founders and investors.

events.name: Bio-IT World Conference & Expo
events.audience: R&D IT, research computing, data science and informatics leaders from pharma and biotech, plus platform vendors.

events.name: ASCO Annual Meeting
events.audience: Oncologists, pharma medical affairs and clinical development teams, payers and patient advocates. The largest clinical oncology meeting.

events.name: BIO International Convention
events.audience: Pharma and biotech BD teams, biotech executives, investors, policy makers. Heavy use of the BIO Partnering meeting system.

events.name: ADA Scientific Sessions
events.audience: Endocrinologists, diabetes researchers, pharma cardiometabolic teams, medical affairs.

events.name: DIA Global Annual Meeting
events.audience: Regulatory affairs, clinical operations, safety and quality leaders from industry, plus FDA, EMA and other health authorities.

events.name: ESMO Congress
events.audience: European and global oncologists, pharma oncology and medical affairs teams, HTA and payer stakeholders.
